author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
#AdamSavage examines the smallest stop-motion animation armature he’s EVER seen, made for the character Septima from #Wildwood. Her screws are SO tiny, Adam could barely see them. Have YOU ever seen screws so SMALL?

Don’t miss @laikastudios’ Wildwood, available in theaters starting Friday, Oct. 23. Get tickets at wildwoodmovie.com
